shared_elements: large single anthropomorphic figure filling the field
long garment with patterned or banded decoration
arms bent with objects or emblems at chest level
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single monumental humanoid figure with an elaborate headdress, a banded/patterned robe and circular disc or rosette motifs at the chest and forearm, arranged vertically to fill the whole field. But A is a frontal, three-dimensional figure whose body carries abstract emblems (disc, curved bands) and no clear held objects, whereas B is a strict profile relief of a bearded winged being holding a bucket and raising a cone, with large feathered wings and fringed drapery that have no counterpart in A.
